name: @workspace/tool-logic-html-preview
description: The HTML Preview tool's logic (D14, docs/tools/specs/html-preview.md): the check of a pasted document — parsed by the DOMParser of a Document passed in, its CSS made to load nothing by a tokenizer of its own — the page's half of drawing it into a sandboxed frame, Copy HTML, the line of what is not shown, the detection. Pure TypeScript: no React, no chrome; the DOM only through parameters.
